description: Deletes outcomes you filed with report_outcome, matched by the hash of the same reporter_key (or X-AllClear-Key header). Optionally narrow to one program_id, institution or decision; with none, all of your rows go. Rows filed by other reporters, rows filed without a key and FundingOS system rows are never touched. Returns the number of rows deleted.

institution.description: Lender name as it appears in the directory.

reporter_key.description: The key you reported with; or send the X-AllClear-Key header.

name: retract_outcome
title: Retract your own reported outcomes
